ITEM 1 | Roasted or baked chicken-like piece with golden-brown, glossy, slightly crisp skin showing darker caramelized patches and fine light speckles (seasoning or minced garlic), roughly 9 cm by 7 cm, sitting at the center-left of the plate, with a thick drumstick-shaped piece on the right side that has pale, smooth, moist exposed flesh about 3 cm wide and 10 cm long | 260
ITEM 2 | Light pale cream-colored piece with smooth, slightly moist surface and soft rounded edges, about 4 cm by 3 cm, tucked at the top edge of the browned piece | 40
ITEM 3 | Bright green slender whole beans, about 0.5 cm thick and 12 to 15 cm long, with firm, crisp-looking texture and matte surface, arranged in a loose diagonal bundle covering roughly one-quarter of the plate on the left side, with a few stem ends pointing down-left | 95
ITEM 4 | Pale green cucumber slices with thin darker green skin edges, about 0.5 cm thick, cut into half-moon and quarter-round pieces, each roughly 4 to 5 cm across, scattered in a cluster on the right edge of the plate next to the chicken, moist and smooth-looking | 70
